title: Discord for Business Vol. 2: Cannes-worthy ad product updates
summary: Built-in rewards, brand lift analytics, mobile Quests… and our Cannes highlights!
body:
This newsletter, built for our partners and friends, provides you and your team with a way to stay ahead of the game on opportunities for your business and stay connected to Discord’s latest updates.

Want this directly in your inbox? Sign up below: 

Sign Up for the Discord for Business Newsletter

Welcome Back from Cannes Lions

‍

‍

We’re fresh off our debut at Cannes Lions, a significant milestone for our expanding ad business. We held panels with leaders from Xbox, Kantar, and Unilever to discuss how Discord’s opt-in, community-first model is reshaping how brands connect with modern gamers.

The message was clear: gaming is now mainstream — and Discord is where those audiences talk, share, and influence each other.

Thank you to all our friends and partners who made our first year in Cannes a memorable one.
